name: SocialChoice.FairDivision.nsmul_egalitarianWelfare_le_utilitarianWelfare
lines: hle : ∀ (i : N), egalitarianWelfare u A ≤ u i (A i)
⊢ Fintype.card N • egalitarianWelfare u A ≤ utilitarianWelfare u A
⊢ Fintype.card N • egalitarianWelfare u A = ∑ _i, egalitarianWelfare u A

steps.tactic:
calc
  Fintype.card N • egalitarianWelfare u A = ∑ _i : N, egalitarianWelfare u A := by
    simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
  _ ≤ ∑ i : N, u i (A i) := (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hle i))
  _ = utilitarianWelfare u A := rfl
